**How to keep your old links from being hijacked: good, better, best.**

Someone re-registered Bitly links from 2011 Burger King and McDonald's tweets.

Nobody touched their accounts. **The link changed hands.**

Old tweets and printed QR codes stay on the level you picked.

**Which level are your links on? Save this.**
bullets: Good: a public shortener. The vendor decides where it points.
Better: your own short domain. A stale CNAME can be taken.
Best: redirects on your main site. Keep the domain renewed.
